name: Sino-German (CSC-DAAD) Postdoc Scholarship Program
summary: To intensify German-Chinese research cooperation and improve funding opportunities for young Chinese scientists and academics, the China Scholarship Council (CSC) and the DAAD have offered a joint programme to support Chinese postdocs since
